title.en: Netflix Uses AI to Recreate Gene Wilder's Voice for Willy Wonka Reality Show
title.zhHans: Netflix 用 AI 复活 Gene Wilder 声音引发伦理争议

searchSummary.en: Netflix partnered with ElevenLabs to recreate Gene Wilder’s voice for ‘Wonka’s The Golden Ticket’ reality series, sparking backlash over AI resurrection of deceased celebrities.
searchSummary.zhHans: Netflix 与 ElevenLabs 合作，用 AI 为新综艺《旺卡的金门票》还原已故演员 Gene Wilder 的声音，引发关于“数字复活”已故名人的伦理争议。

summary.en: On July 1, 2026, Netflix announced 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket,' a nine-episode reality competition series premiering September 23, whose trailer features an AI-generated recreation of Gene Wilder's voice. Netflix partnered with AI audio company ElevenLabs for the voice recreation, and Wilder's estate consented to the use. The announcement triggered immediate backlash on social media, with critics labeling it 'digital necromancy' and questioning the ethics of using AI to resurrect deceased performers. While Wilder's estate had consented, the incident revived the broader debate about AI voice cloning, posthumous consent, and the boundaries of AI-generated entertainment.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月1日，Netflix 宣布推出九集真人秀竞赛系列《旺卡的金门票》（Wonka's The Golden Ticket），将于9月23日首播，其预告片使用了 AI 生成的 Gene Wilder 声音旁白。Netflix 与 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 合作进行声音还原，并获得了 Wilder 遗产管理方的同意。该公告在社交媒体上立即引发反弹，批评者称之为'数字 necromancy'，并质疑使用 AI 复活已故表演者的伦理问题。虽然 Wilder 遗产管理方已同意，但该事件重新点燃了关于 AI 语音克隆、死后同意和 AI 生成娱乐边界的更广泛辩论。

narrative.en:
Netflix announced 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket,' a reality competition series set in the world of Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory. The show, premiering September 23, 2026, will follow 12 contestants as they navigate challenges inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory for a grand prize. Netflix partnered with ElevenLabs, the AI audio company known for celebrity voice cloning, to recreate the voice of Gene Wilder, who played Willy Wonka in the iconic 1971 film and died in 2016 at age 83.

The trailer released on July 1 features Wilder's AI-generated voice narrating: 'A whole new generation of real-life Golden Ticket holders will compete for a life-changing prize or say a most unfortunate goodbye.' Wilder's estate gave consent to the use, but the announcement faced immediate backlash. Social media users called it 'digital necromancy' and 'AI slop,' arguing that consent from an estate does not equate to the deceased person's wishes. Some fans noted the AI voice 'didn't even sound like him.'

The controversy revived the debate that began with Scarlett Johansson's 2024 voice dispute with OpenAI: where is the line between legitimate license of a deceased performer's likeness and the commodification of identity without genuine consent? The incident also highlighted the growing capability of AI voice cloning technology, now accessible enough for major streaming platforms to use in flagship productions.
narrative.zhHans:
Netflix 宣布推出《旺卡的金门票》，一档以威利·旺卡和巧克力工厂世界为背景的真人秀竞赛系列。该节目定于2026年9月23日首播，将跟随12名参赛者在旺卡巧克力工厂内完成挑战，争夺终极大奖。Netflix 与以名人声音克隆闻名的 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 合作，还原 Gene Wilder 的声音。Wilder 在1971年的经典电影中饰演威利·旺卡，于2016年去世，享年83岁。

7月1日发布的预告片中，Wilder 的 AI 生成声音旁白道：'新一代真正的金门票持有者将竞争改变人生的奖品，或是不幸地说再见。'Wilder 的遗产管理方同意使用，但该公告立即遭到强烈反对。社交媒体用户称其为'数字 necromancy'和'AI 垃圾'，认为遗产管理方的同意不等于逝者本人的意愿。部分粉丝指出 AI 声音'甚至不像他'。

这场争议重新点燃了从2024年 Scarlett Johansson 与 OpenAI 的声音纠纷开始的辩论：在合法授权已故表演者肖像和未经真正同意的身份商品化之间，界限在哪里？该事件也凸显了 AI 语音克隆技术日益增长的能力——如今已足够成熟，可供主流流媒体平台在旗舰制作中使用。

text.en: Netflix partnered with ElevenLabs to recreate Gene Wilder's voice for 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket,' a reality competition series premiering September 23, 2026.
text.zhHans: Netflix 与 ElevenLabs 合作，为将于2026年9月23日首播的真人秀《旺卡的金门票》还原 Gene Wilder 的声音。

text.en: Wilder's estate consented to the use of his voice via AI recreation.
text.zhHans: Wilder 的遗产管理方同意以 AI 还原方式使用他的声音。

text.en: Critics argued that estate consent does not equal the deceased person's wishes, and that AI resurrection of deceased performers sets a dangerous precedent for posthumous identity exploitation.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为遗产管理方的同意不等于逝者本人的意愿，AI 复活已故表演者为此后身份剥削开创了危险先例。

description.en: Mainstream use of AI voice cloning for deceased celebrities normalizes posthumous digital resurrection, raising fundamental questions about consent, identity rights, and the boundary between tribute and exploitation.
description.zhHans: 主流平台使用 AI 语音克隆还原已故名人，使死后数字复活正常化，引发了关于同意、身份权利以及致敬与剥削之间界限的根本性问题。

description.en: The controversy reinforces public distrust of AI-generated content and could accelerate calls for regulation of AI voice cloning without explicit consent.
description.zhHans: 争议加剧了公众对 AI 生成内容的不信任，可能加速对未经明确同意进行 AI 语音克隆的监管呼声。
